content.what_it_is: Commented MATLAB bathymetry-plotting script with user inputs for the source directory and colorbar toggle (L8-L15). It loads a depth grid and derives half-degree geographic coordinates (L19-L27), plots negated depth (L35-L36), conditionally applies demcmap if installed (L38-L42), and conditionally labels a colorbar (L47-L51).

matrix dimensions n and m defined at L21
grid spacings dx and dy defined at L24-L25
coordinate vectors x and y defined at L26-L27
figure dimensions wid and len defined at L30-L31

unresolved: Potential cross-line sign mismatch at L36 and L41: pcolor displays -dep while demcmap is configured from dep; whether colors and limits describe the displayed sign correctly depends on the undocumented depth convention and demcmap behavior.
MATLAB pcolor at L36 ordinarily renders cells between vertices and omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces; no compensation is present if full-grid coverage is intended.
